meta.name: game-build
meta.description: Build the game for its approved target runtime. Compress GAME_DESIGN and ART_DIRECTION into a minimal BUILD_BRIEF, hand it to the current coding agent or another strong model to implement a fully playable build, and iterate against real runs and captured evidence. Use for implement the approved game design, build the game prototype, turn this design into a running game. 游戏构建执行。把批准后的 GAME_DESIGN 与 ART_DIRECTION 压缩成最小 BUILD_BRIEF，交给当前编码智能体或其他强模型，在选定的目标运行环境中实现可完整游玩的版本，并通过真实运行和证据迭代。用于把批准的游戏方案实现成可运行游戏。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成批准游戏设计的可运行版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有批准的游戏设计,想快速得到可游玩的原型。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a playable build from your approved game design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an approved game design and want a playable build quickly.

howto.what: 把已批准的游戏设计方案和美术方向压缩成最小构建说明，交给当前编码智能体或另一个强模型实现可完整游玩的版本，用真实运行和截图等证据反复迭代修复。最后产出构建说明、可运行游戏和验证记录。
howto.when: 当你说要实现已批准的游戏方案、构建游戏原型、或把设计变成可运行游戏时触发；前提是项目里已有 GAME_DESIGN.md 和 ART_DIRECTION.md。

say.text: 把批准的游戏设计实现成可运行版本。
say.note: 生成 BUILD_BRIEF 并开始编码实现。

say.text: 先做灰盒验证核心循环，再打磨视觉。
say.note: 按完成循环分阶段推进并留证据。

say.text: 构建原型并跑权威验证，保存证据。
say.note: 输出写入 qa/evidence 与验证记录。

howto.what_en: Compress the approved game design and art direction into a minimal build brief, pass it to a strong model for a playable build, and iterate on real runs and captured evidence. Deliver the brief, runnable game, and verification record.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to implement the approved game design, build the game prototype, or turn the design into a running game. Requires GAME_DESIGN.md and ART_DIRECTION.md to already exist.

say_en.text: Turn the approved game design into a runnable build.
Graybox the core loop first, then polish the visuals.
say_en.note: Follows the completion loop and keeps evidence.

say_en.text: Build the prototype and run the authoritative verification.
say_en.note: Saves outputs to qa/evidence and verification.json.
